about_the_game:
PRESENTATION

The Ashen Baron is an old-school RPG in the Style of Skyfall, Vagrant Hearts and The Witch Doctor.

In a kingdom scarred by civil war, a wandering hero seeks to restore hope to its devastated lands. Arriving at a once-thriving farming village now under siege by the ruthless Reapers, he discovers a fallen leader—a Baron who has succumbed to despair and renounced his post.

Tasked with rekindling the Baron's lost courage, the hero must inspire him to rally the villagers and stand against their oppressors. Together, they confront the shadows of their past as they strive to reclaim their home and uncover the strength buried within. In a journey of redemption, can they rise against darkness and defend what remains?

FEATURES

  • Deep narrative that unfolds through exploration and character interactions, revealing the rich lore of the kingdom and its struggles

  • Complex characters with unique backstories and arcs, allowing players to witness personal growth and transformation throughout the journey

  • Visually stunning, cinematic cutscenes that enhance key story moments and immerse players in the emotional depth of the characters’ struggles

  • Environments and character designs inspired by classic JRPGs, featuring vibrant colors and lush landscapes that bring the world to life

  • Explore the richly detailed world to discover dozens of hidden items. Players are encouraged to explore every nook and cranny, rewarding their curiosity with valuable discoveries that can aid them in their quest
